headline: AI narrows the gap between lone attackers and state hackers
body: A modest day. Anthropic case studies showed AI letting small actors do more in Russian- and Chinese-linked operations, with humans still choosing targets, which raises Catastrophic Risk and Self-Destruction. OpenAI's new Agents API public beta adds AI Autonomy, nudging Conquerors, Descendants and Zookeeper. Cohere's 50-language translation model slightly eased Power Concentration. Horizon Balance slipped to -6.77.
movers_note: Self-Destruction +0.2 from Anthropic's attacker case studies (+0.23); Conquerors +0.2 from the Agents API (+0.10) and the case studies (+0.06); Descendants +0.1 from the Agents API (+0.13).
